Give me the governance scorecard of each: WITH latest AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces) SELECT displayName, syncedAt, itemCount, JSON_VALUE(governanceSummaryJson,'$.pillars.health') AS health_score, JSON_VALUE(governanceSummaryJson,'$.pillars.protect') AS protect_score, JSON_VALUE(governanceSummaryJson,'$.pillars.trust') AS trust_score, JSON_VALUE(governanceSummaryJson,'$.findings.critical') AS critical_findings, JSON_VALUE(governanceSummaryJson,'$.findings.high') AS high_findings FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY displayName
Which workspaces are not assigned to a d: WITH latest AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces) SELECT displayName, fabricId, itemCount FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 AND fabricDomainId IS NULL
Which items are failing?: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, displayName, snapshotId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces) SELECT l.displayName AS workspace, f.displayName AS item, f.itemType, f.lastRefresh FROM latest l JOIN dbo.FabricItems f ON f.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND f.snapshotId = l.snapshotId WHERE l.rn = 1 AND f.health = 'failing' ORDER BY l.displayName, f.itemType, f.displayName
What is the sensitivity label coverage p: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, displayName, snapshotId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces) SELECT l.displayName AS workspace, SUM(CASE WHEN f.sensitivityMetadataAvailable = 1 AND ISNULL(f.sensitivity,'') <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS labeled, SUM(CASE WHEN f.sensitivityMetadataAvailable = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS measurable, SUM(CASE WHEN f.sensitivityMetadataAvailable = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unknown, CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.sensitivityMetadataAvailable = 1 AND ISNULL(f.sensitivity,'') <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN f.sensitivityMetadataAvailable = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS decimal(5,1)) AS labeled_pct FROM latest l JOIN dbo.FabricItems f ON f.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND f.snapshotId = l.snapshotId WHERE l.rn = 1 GROUP BY l.displayName
What is the endorsement coverage?: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, displayName, snapshotId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces) SELECT l.displayName AS workspace, SUM(CASE WHEN f.endorsement IN ('promoted','certified') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS endorsed, SUM(CASE WHEN f.endorsement = 'certified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS certified, SUM(CASE WHEN f.endorsementMetadataAvailable = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS measurable, SUM(CASE WHEN f.endorsementMetadataAvailable = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unknown FROM latest l JOIN dbo.FabricItems f ON f.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND f.snapshotId = l.snapshotId WHERE l.rn = 1 GROUP BY l.displayName
Which semantic models and reports have n: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, displayName, snapshotId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces) SELECT l.displayName AS workspace, f.itemType, f.displayName AS item FROM latest l JOIN dbo.FabricItems f ON f.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND f.snapshotId = l.snapshotId WHERE l.rn = 1 AND f.itemType IN ('SemanticModel','Report') AND ISNULL(f.description,'') = '' ORDER BY l.displayName, f.itemType, f.displayName
How many items have no tags?: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, displayName, snapshotId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces) SELECT l.displayName AS workspace, SUM(CASE WHEN f.tagMetadataAvailable = 1 AND ISNULL(f.tags,'') IN ('','[]') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS untagged, SUM(CASE WHEN f.tagMetadataAvailable = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS measurable, SUM(CASE WHEN f.tagMetadataAvailable = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unknown FROM latest l JOIN dbo.FabricItems f ON f.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND f.snapshotId = l.snapshotId WHERE l.rn = 1 GROUP BY l.displayName
Which items have no known owner?: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, displayName, snapshotId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces) SELECT l.displayName AS workspace, f.itemType, f.displayName AS item FROM latest l JOIN dbo.FabricItems f ON f.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND f.snapshotId = l.snapshotId WHERE l.rn = 1 AND f.ownerMetadataAvailable = 1 AND ISNULL(f.ownerEmail,'') = '' ORDER BY l.displayName, f.displayName
Which items are stale (not updated for m: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, displayName, snapshotId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces) SELECT l.displayName AS workspace, f.itemType, f.displayName AS item, f.itemUpdatedAt, f.lastRefresh FROM latest l JOIN dbo.FabricItems f ON f.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND f.snapshotId = l.snapshotId WHERE l.rn = 1 AND COALESCE(f.lastRefresh, f.itemUpdatedAt) < DATEADD(day, -90, SYSUTCDATETIME()) ORDER BY COALESCE(f.lastRefresh, f.itemUpdatedAt)
Which items failed the most jobs?: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, displayName, snapshotId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces) SELECT TOP 10 l.displayName AS workspace, j.itemName, j.jobType, COUNT(*) AS failed_runs, MAX(j.startedAt) AS last_failure FROM latest l JOIN dbo.JobRuns j ON j.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND j.snapshotId = l.snapshotId WHERE l.rn = 1 AND j.status = 'failed' GROUP BY l.displayName, j.itemName, j.jobType ORDER BY failed_runs DESC
List the recent operational incidents: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, displayName, snapshotId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces) SELECT TOP 20 l.displayName AS workspace, o.itemName, o.itemType, o.jobType, o.occurredAt, o.durationSec FROM latest l JOIN dbo.OperationalIncidents o ON o.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND o.snapshotId = l.snapshotId WHERE l.rn = 1 ORDER BY o.occurredAt DESC
Are there broken lineage edges?: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, displayName, snapshotId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces) SELECT l.displayName AS workspace, s.displayName AS source_item, e.relation, t.displayName AS target_item FROM latest l JOIN dbo.LineageEdges e ON e.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND e.snapshotId = l.snapshotId LEFT JOIN dbo.FabricItems s ON s.fabricId = e.sourceFabricId AND s.snapshotId = e.snapshotId LEFT JOIN dbo.FabricItems t ON t.fabricId = e.targetFabricId AND t.snapshotId = e.snapshotId WHERE l.rn = 1 AND e.broken = 1
Who are the workspace admins and are the: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, displayName, snapshotId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces) SELECT l.displayName AS workspace, p.displayName, p.email, p.kind, p.workspaceRole, p.[external] FROM latest l JOIN dbo.Principals p ON p.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND p.snapshotId = l.snapshotId WHERE l.rn = 1 AND (p.workspaceRole = 'Admin' OR p.[external] = 1) ORDER BY l.displayName, p.workspaceRole
Which service principals have access and: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, displayName, snapshotId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces) SELECT l.displayName AS workspace, p.displayName AS principal, COUNT(DISTINCT g.itemFabricId) AS items, MAX(g.accessLevel) AS max_access FROM latest l JOIN dbo.AccessGrants g ON g.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND g.snapshotId = l.snapshotId LEFT JOIN dbo.Principals p ON p.principalId = g.principalRef AND p.snapshotId = g.snapshotId WHERE l.rn = 1 AND g.flag = 'servicePrincipal' GROUP BY l.displayName, p.displayName ORDER BY items DESC
Which items are shared directly outside: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, displayName, snapshotId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces) SELECT TOP 20 l.displayName AS workspace, f.displayName AS item, f.itemType, COUNT(DISTINCT g.principalRef) AS direct_principals FROM latest l JOIN dbo.AccessGrants g ON g.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND g.snapshotId = l.snapshotId JOIN dbo.FabricItems f ON f.fabricId = g.itemFabricId AND f.snapshotId = g.snapshotId WHERE l.rn = 1 AND g.source = 'directShare' GROUP BY l.displayName, f.displayName, f.itemType ORDER BY direct_principals DESC
Which external datasets from OpenLineage: SELECT d.platform, d.namespace, d.name, d.lastSeenAt FROM dbo.ExternalDatasets d WHERE d.state = 'to_link' ORDER BY d.platform, d.name
When was each workspace last synchronize: SELECT w.displayName AS workspace, r.status, r.startedAt, r.finishedAt, r.itemsSynced, r.failureMessage FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id ORDER BY startedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.SyncRuns) r LEFT JOIN dbo.WorkspaceScopes w ON w.id = r.workspace_id WHERE r.rn = 1
Show the downstream lineage of the LH_He: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, snapshotId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces), edges AS (SELECT e.sourceFabricId, e.targetFabricId, e.relation, e.broken FROM latest l JOIN dbo.LineageEdges e ON e.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND e.snapshotId = l.snapshotId WHERE l.rn = 1), items AS (SELECT i.fabricId, i.displayName, i.itemType, i.health FROM latest l JOIN dbo.FabricItems i ON i.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND i.snapshotId = l.snapshotId WHERE l.rn = 1), failures AS (SELECT j.itemFabricId, COUNT(*) AS failedRuns FROM latest l JOIN dbo.JobRuns j ON j.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND j.snapshotId = l.snapshotId WHERE l.rn = 1 AND j.status = 'failed' AND j.startedAt >= DATEADD(day, -14, SYSUTCDATETIME()) GROUP BY j.itemFabricId), root AS (SELECT fabricId FROM items WHERE displayName = 'LH_Healthcare_Clinical'), hop1 AS (SELECT e.*, 1 AS hop FROM edges e JOIN root r ON e.sourceFabricId = r.fabricId), hop2 AS (SELECT e.*, 2 AS hop FROM edges e WHERE e.sourceFabricId IN (SELECT targetFabricId FROM hop1)), hop3 AS (SELECT e.*, 3 AS hop FROM edges e WHERE e.sourceFabricId IN (SELECT targetFabricId FROM hop2)), hop4 AS (SELECT e.*, 4 AS hop FROM edges e WHERE e.sourceFabricId IN (SELECT targetFabricId FROM hop3)), walk AS (SELECT * FROM hop1 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM hop2 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM hop3 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM hop4) SELECT s.displayName AS source, s.itemType AS source_type, w.relation, t.displayName AS target, t.itemType AS target_type, MAX(CAST(w.broken AS int)) AS broken, t.health AS target_health, COALESCE(MAX(f.failedRuns), 0) AS failed_runs_14d, MIN(w.hop) AS hop FROM walk w JOIN items s ON s.fabricId = w.sourceFabricId JOIN items t ON t.fabricId = w.targetFabricId LEFT JOIN failures f ON f.itemFabricId = w.targetFabricId GROUP BY s.displayName, s.itemType, w.relation, t.displayName, t.itemType, t.health ORDER BY hop, source, target
Show me all measures containing 'sales': WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, snapshotId, displayName, fabricDomainId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces), docs AS (SELECT ce.workspace_id, ce.snapshotId, ce.itemFabricId, ce.label, l.displayName AS workspace, STRING_AGG(CAST(SUBSTRING(ce.value,14,4000) AS nvarchar(max)),'') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SUBSTRING(ce.value,4,4)) AS doc FROM latest l JOIN dbo.ConfigEntries ce ON ce.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND ce.snapshotId = l.snapshotId AND l.rn = 1 WHERE ce.section = '__schema__' GROUP BY ce.workspace_id, ce.snapshotId, ce.itemFabricId, ce.label, l.displayName) SELECT m.name AS measure_name, d.label AS model_table, fi.displayName AS semantic_model, d.workspace, m.expr AS dax_expression, CASE WHEN m.name LIKE '%sales%' THEN 'measure name' WHEN m.expr LIKE '%sales%' THEN 'DAX expression' WHEN d.label LIKE '%sales%' THEN 'table name' ELSE 'semantic model name' END AS matched_on FROM docs d JOIN dbo.FabricItems fi ON fi.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND fi.snapshotId = d.snapshotId AND fi.fabricId = d.itemFabricId CROSS APPLY OPENJSON(d.doc, '$.measures') WITH (name nvarchar(400) '$.name', expr nvarchar(max) '$.expr') m WHERE JSON_VALUE(d.doc, '$.objectType') = 'Model table' AND (m.name LIKE '%sales%' OR d.label LIKE '%sales%' OR fi.displayName LIKE '%sales%' OR m.expr LIKE '%sales%') ORDER BY fi.displayName, d.label, m.name
List every measure of each semantic mode: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, snapshotId, displayName, fabricDomainId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces), docs AS (SELECT ce.workspace_id, ce.snapshotId, ce.itemFabricId, ce.label, l.displayName AS workspace, STRING_AGG(CAST(SUBSTRING(ce.value,14,4000) AS nvarchar(max)),'') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SUBSTRING(ce.value,4,4)) AS doc FROM latest l JOIN dbo.ConfigEntries ce ON ce.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND ce.snapshotId = l.snapshotId AND l.rn = 1 WHERE ce.section = '__schema__' GROUP BY ce.workspace_id, ce.snapshotId, ce.itemFabricId, ce.label, l.displayName) SELECT fi.displayName AS semantic_model, d.workspace, d.label AS model_table, m.name AS measure_name, m.expr AS dax_expression FROM docs d JOIN dbo.FabricItems fi ON fi.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND fi.snapshotId = d.snapshotId AND fi.fabricId = d.itemFabricId CROSS APPLY OPENJSON(d.doc, '$.measures') WITH (name nvarchar(400) '$.name', expr nvarchar(max) '$.expr') m WHERE JSON_VALUE(d.doc, '$.objectType') = 'Model table' ORDER BY fi.displayName, d.label, m.name
Which tables and columns does the Alpine: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, snapshotId, displayName, fabricDomainId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces), docs AS (SELECT ce.workspace_id, ce.snapshotId, ce.itemFabricId, ce.label, l.displayName AS workspace, STRING_AGG(CAST(SUBSTRING(ce.value,14,4000) AS nvarchar(max)),'') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SUBSTRING(ce.value,4,4)) AS doc FROM latest l JOIN dbo.ConfigEntries ce ON ce.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND ce.snapshotId = l.snapshotId AND l.rn = 1 WHERE ce.section = '__schema__' GROUP BY ce.workspace_id, ce.snapshotId, ce.itemFabricId, ce.label, l.displayName) SELECT fi.displayName AS item, fi.itemType, d.label AS table_name, JSON_VALUE(d.doc, '$.objectType') AS object_type, c.name AS column_name, c.dataType AS data_type FROM docs d JOIN dbo.FabricItems fi ON fi.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND fi.snapshotId = d.snapshotId AND fi.fabricId = d.itemFabricId CROSS APPLY OPENJSON(d.doc, '$.columns') WITH (name nvarchar(400) '$.name', dataType nvarchar(60) '$.dataType') c WHERE fi.displayName LIKE '%AlpineRent Sales Model%' ORDER BY d.label, c.name
Where is a column named customer_key use: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, snapshotId, displayName, fabricDomainId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces), docs AS (SELECT ce.workspace_id, ce.snapshotId, ce.itemFabricId, ce.label, l.displayName AS workspace, STRING_AGG(CAST(SUBSTRING(ce.value,14,4000) AS nvarchar(max)),'') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SUBSTRING(ce.value,4,4)) AS doc FROM latest l JOIN dbo.ConfigEntries ce ON ce.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND ce.snapshotId = l.snapshotId AND l.rn = 1 WHERE ce.section = '__schema__' GROUP BY ce.workspace_id, ce.snapshotId, ce.itemFabricId, ce.label, l.displayName) SELECT c.name AS column_name, d.label AS table_name, JSON_VALUE(d.doc, '$.objectType') AS object_type, fi.displayName AS item, fi.itemType, d.workspace FROM docs d JOIN dbo.FabricItems fi ON fi.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND fi.snapshotId = d.snapshotId AND fi.fabricId = d.itemFabricId CROSS APPLY OPENJSON(d.doc, '$.columns') WITH (name nvarchar(400) '$.name') c WHERE c.name LIKE '%customer_key%' ORDER BY d.workspace, fi.displayName, d.label
Count tables, columns and measures by ob: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, snapshotId, displayName, fabricDomainId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces), docs AS (SELECT ce.workspace_id, ce.snapshotId, ce.itemFabricId, ce.label, l.displayName AS workspace, STRING_AGG(CAST(SUBSTRING(ce.value,14,4000) AS nvarchar(max)),'') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SUBSTRING(ce.value,4,4)) AS doc FROM latest l JOIN dbo.ConfigEntries ce ON ce.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND ce.snapshotId = l.snapshotId AND l.rn = 1 WHERE ce.section = '__schema__' GROUP BY ce.workspace_id, ce.snapshotId, ce.itemFabricId, ce.label, l.displayName) SELECT JSON_VALUE(d.doc, '$.objectType') AS object_type, COUNT(*) AS objects, SUM(cc.n) AS columns, SUM(mc.n) AS measures FROM docs d CROSS APPLY (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM OPENJSON(d.doc, '$.columns')) cc CROSS APPLY (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM OPENJSON(d.doc, '$.measures')) mc WHERE JSON_VALUE(d.doc, '$.objectType') <> 'Atlas item metadata' GROUP BY JSON_VALUE(d.doc, '$.objectType') ORDER BY objects DESC
Show the DAX dependencies of the measure: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, snapshotId, displayName, fabricDomainId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces), docs AS (SELECT ce.workspace_id, ce.snapshotId, ce.itemFabricId, ce.label, l.displayName AS workspace, STRING_AGG(CAST(SUBSTRING(ce.value,14,4000) AS nvarchar(max)),'') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SUBSTRING(ce.value,4,4)) AS doc FROM latest l JOIN dbo.ConfigEntries ce ON ce.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND ce.snapshotId = l.snapshotId AND l.rn = 1 WHERE ce.section = '__semantic_model_evidence__' GROUP BY ce.workspace_id, ce.snapshotId, ce.itemFabricId, ce.label, l.displayName) SELECT fi.displayName AS semantic_model, dep.[table] + '[' + dep.[object] + ']' AS source, dep.objectType AS source_type, 'references' AS relation, dep.referencedTable + '[' + dep.referencedObject + ']' AS target, dep.referencedObjectType AS target_type FROM docs d JOIN dbo.FabricItems fi ON fi.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND fi.snapshotId = d.snapshotId AND fi.fabricId = d.itemFabricId CROSS APPLY OPENJSON(d.doc, '$.dependencies') WITH ([table] nvarchar(400), [object] nvarchar(400), objectType nvarchar(60), referencedTable nvarchar(400), referencedObject nvarchar(400), referencedObjectType nvarchar(60)) dep WHERE fi.displayName LIKE '%AlpineRent Sales Model%' ORDER BY source, target
Show the relationships of the Healthcare: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, snapshotId, displayName, fabricDomainId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces), docs AS (SELECT ce.workspace_id, ce.snapshotId, ce.itemFabricId, ce.label, l.displayName AS workspace, STRING_AGG(CAST(SUBSTRING(ce.value,14,4000) AS nvarchar(max)),'') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SUBSTRING(ce.value,4,4)) AS doc FROM latest l JOIN dbo.ConfigEntries ce ON ce.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND ce.snapshotId = l.snapshotId AND l.rn = 1 WHERE ce.section = '__semantic_model_evidence__' GROUP BY ce.workspace_id, ce.snapshotId, ce.itemFabricId, ce.label, l.displayName) SELECT fi.displayName AS semantic_model, r.fromTable + '[' + r.fromColumn + ']' AS source, 'Model table' AS source_type, 'relationship' AS relation, r.toTable + '[' + r.toColumn + ']' AS target, 'Model table' AS target_type FROM docs d JOIN dbo.FabricItems fi ON fi.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND fi.snapshotId = d.snapshotId AND fi.fabricId = d.itemFabricId CROSS APPLY OPENJSON(d.doc, '$.relationships') WITH (fromTable nvarchar(400), fromColumn nvarchar(400), toTable nvarchar(400), toColumn nvarchar(400)) r WHERE fi.displayName LIKE '%HealthcareOperationsModel%' ORDER BY source
Show the object-level lineage of the tab: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, snapshotId, displayName, fabricDomainId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces), docs AS (SELECT ce.workspace_id, ce.snapshotId, ce.itemFabricId, ce.label, l.displayName AS workspace, STRING_AGG(CAST(SUBSTRING(ce.value,14,4000) AS nvarchar(max)),'') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SUBSTRING(ce.value,4,4)) AS doc FROM latest l JOIN dbo.ConfigEntries ce ON ce.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND ce.snapshotId = l.snapshotId AND l.rn = 1 WHERE ce.section = '__object_edges__' GROUP BY ce.workspace_id, ce.snapshotId, ce.itemFabricId, ce.label, l.displayName) SELECT DISTINCT e.sourceName + ' (' + COALESCE(si.displayName, 'external') + ')' AS source, e.sourceKind AS source_type, e.relation, e.targetName + ' (' + COALESCE(ti.displayName, 'external') + ')' AS target, e.targetKind AS target_type, d.workspace FROM docs d CROSS APPLY OPENJSON(d.doc) WITH (sourceItem nvarchar(64) '$.source.itemId', sourceKind nvarchar(60) '$.source.kind', sourceName nvarchar(400) '$.source.name', relation nvarchar(100) '$.relation', targetItem nvarchar(64) '$.target.itemId', targetKind nvarchar(60) '$.target.kind', targetName nvarchar(400) '$.target.name') e LEFT JOIN dbo.FabricItems si ON si.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND si.snapshotId = d.snapshotId AND si.fabricId = e.sourceItem LEFT JOIN dbo.FabricItems ti ON ti.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND ti.snapshotId = d.snapshotId AND ti.fabricId = e.targetItem WHERE e.relation <> 'contains' AND e.sourceKind <> 'dataAgentElement' AND e.targetKind <> 'dataAgentElement' AND (e.sourceName LIKE '%fact_sales%' OR e.targetName LIKE '%fact_sales%')
Which tables do notebooks read and write: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, snapshotId, displayName, fabricDomainId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces), docs AS (SELECT ce.workspace_id, ce.snapshotId, ce.itemFabricId, ce.label, l.displayName AS workspace, STRING_AGG(CAST(SUBSTRING(ce.value,14,4000) AS nvarchar(max)),'') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SUBSTRING(ce.value,4,4)) AS doc FROM latest l JOIN dbo.ConfigEntries ce ON ce.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND ce.snapshotId = l.snapshotId AND l.rn = 1 WHERE ce.section = '__object_edges__' GROUP BY ce.workspace_id, ce.snapshotId, ce.itemFabricId, ce.label, l.displayName) SELECT DISTINCT e.sourceName + ' (' + COALESCE(si.displayName, 'external') + ')' AS source, e.sourceKind AS source_type, e.relation, e.targetName + ' (' + COALESCE(ti.displayName, 'external') + ')' AS target, e.targetKind AS target_type, d.workspace FROM docs d CROSS APPLY OPENJSON(d.doc) WITH (sourceItem nvarchar(64) '$.source.itemId', sourceKind nvarchar(60) '$.source.kind', sourceName nvarchar(400) '$.source.name', relation nvarchar(100) '$.relation', targetItem nvarchar(64) '$.target.itemId', targetKind nvarchar(60) '$.target.kind', targetName nvarchar(400) '$.target.name') e LEFT JOIN dbo.FabricItems si ON si.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND si.snapshotId = d.snapshotId AND si.fabricId = e.sourceItem LEFT JOIN dbo.FabricItems ti ON ti.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND ti.snapshotId = d.snapshotId AND ti.fabricId = e.targetItem WHERE e.relation IN ('reads', 'writes') ORDER BY d.workspace, source
Which source tables and columns feed the: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, snapshotId, displayName, fabricDomainId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces), docs AS (SELECT ce.workspace_id, ce.snapshotId, ce.itemFabricId, ce.label, l.displayName AS workspace, STRING_AGG(CAST(SUBSTRING(ce.value,14,4000) AS nvarchar(max)),'') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SUBSTRING(ce.value,4,4)) AS doc FROM latest l JOIN dbo.ConfigEntries ce ON ce.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND ce.snapshotId = l.snapshotId AND l.rn = 1 WHERE ce.section = '__object_edges__' GROUP BY ce.workspace_id, ce.snapshotId, ce.itemFabricId, ce.label, l.displayName) SELECT DISTINCT e.sourceName + ' (' + COALESCE(si.displayName, 'external') + ')' AS source, e.sourceKind AS source_type, e.relation, e.targetName + ' (' + COALESCE(ti.displayName, 'external') + ')' AS target, e.targetKind AS target_type, d.workspace FROM docs d CROSS APPLY OPENJSON(d.doc) WITH (sourceItem nvarchar(64) '$.source.itemId', sourceKind nvarchar(60) '$.source.kind', sourceName nvarchar(400) '$.source.name', relation nvarchar(100) '$.relation', targetItem nvarchar(64) '$.target.itemId', targetKind nvarchar(60) '$.target.kind', targetName nvarchar(400) '$.target.name') e LEFT JOIN dbo.FabricItems si ON si.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND si.snapshotId = d.snapshotId AND si.fabricId = e.sourceItem LEFT JOIN dbo.FabricItems ti ON ti.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND ti.snapshotId = d.snapshotId AND ti.fabricId = e.targetItem WHERE e.relation IN ('binds entity', 'binds property') ORDER BY d.workspace, source
Which domain is each workspace assigned: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, snapshotId, displayName, fabricDomainId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces), docs AS (SELECT ce.workspace_id, ce.snapshotId, ce.itemFabricId, ce.label, l.displayName AS workspace, STRING_AGG(CAST(SUBSTRING(ce.value,14,4000) AS nvarchar(max)),'') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SUBSTRING(ce.value,4,4)) AS doc FROM latest l JOIN dbo.ConfigEntries ce ON ce.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND ce.snapshotId = l.snapshotId AND l.rn = 1 WHERE ce.section = '__governance_evidence__' GROUP BY ce.workspace_id, ce.snapshotId, ce.itemFabricId, ce.label, l.displayName), domains AS (SELECT DISTINCT x.id, x.displayName FROM docs d CROSS APPLY OPENJSON(d.doc, '$.domains.entries') WITH (id nvarchar(64) '$.id', displayName nvarchar(200) '$.displayName') x) SELECT l.displayName AS workspace, COALESCE(dm.displayName, CASE WHEN l.fabricDomainId IS NULL THEN 'not assigned' ELSE l.fabricDomainId END) AS domain FROM latest l LEFT JOIN domains dm ON dm.id = l.fabricDomainId WHERE l.rn = 1 ORDER BY domain, workspace
Which tenant settings are enabled for se: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, snapshotId, displayName, fabricDomainId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces), docs AS (SELECT ce.workspace_id, ce.snapshotId, ce.itemFabricId, ce.label, l.displayName AS workspace, STRING_AGG(CAST(SUBSTRING(ce.value,14,4000) AS nvarchar(max)),'') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SUBSTRING(ce.value,4,4)) AS doc FROM latest l JOIN dbo.ConfigEntries ce ON ce.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND ce.snapshotId = l.snapshotId AND l.rn = 1 WHERE ce.section = '__governance_evidence__' GROUP BY ce.workspace_id, ce.snapshotId, ce.itemFabricId, ce.label, l.displayName) SELECT DISTINCT t.[group] AS setting_group, t.title, t.settingName, t.enabled FROM docs d CROSS APPLY OPENJSON(d.doc, '$.tenantSettings.entries') WITH ([group] nvarchar(200) '$.group', title nvarchar(400) '$.title', settingName nvarchar(200) '$.settingName', enabled bit '$.enabled') t WHERE t.title LIKE '%service principal%' OR t.title LIKE '%external%' OR t.title LIKE '%guest%' ORDER BY setting_group, t.title
Show the OneLake data access roles and t: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, snapshotId, displayName, fabricDomainId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces), docs AS (SELECT ce.workspace_id, ce.snapshotId, ce.itemFabricId, ce.label, l.displayName AS workspace, STRING_AGG(CAST(SUBSTRING(ce.value,14,4000) AS nvarchar(max)),'') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SUBSTRING(ce.value,4,4)) AS doc FROM latest l JOIN dbo.ConfigEntries ce ON ce.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND ce.snapshotId = l.snapshotId AND l.rn = 1 WHERE ce.section = '__governance_evidence__' GROUP BY ce.workspace_id, ce.snapshotId, ce.itemFabricId, ce.label, l.displayName) SELECT d.workspace, JSON_VALUE(d.doc, '$.network.policy.inboundPublicAccess') AS inbound_public_access, JSON_VALUE(d.doc, '$.network.policy.outboundPublicAccess') AS outbound_public_access, JSON_VALUE(d.doc, '$.oneLakeRoles.status.status') AS onelake_roles_status, fi.displayName AS item, r.roleName, r.permissions, r.paths, r.itemMemberCount, r.rowSecurity, r.columnSecurity FROM docs d OUTER APPLY OPENJSON(d.doc, '$.oneLakeRoles.entries') WITH (itemId nvarchar(64) '$.itemId', roleName nvarchar(200) '$.roleName', permissions nvarchar(max) '$.permissions' AS JSON, paths nvarchar(max) '$.paths' AS JSON, itemMemberCount int '$.itemMemberCount', rowSecurity bit '$.rowSecurity', columnSecurity bit '$.columnSecurity') r LEFT JOIN dbo.FabricItems fi ON fi.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND fi.snapshotId = d.snapshotId AND fi.fabricId = r.itemId ORDER BY d.workspace, item, r.roleName
Which pages does each report have?: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, snapshotId, displayName, fabricDomainId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces) SELECT fi.displayName AS report, l.displayName AS workspace, ce.label AS page FROM latest l JOIN dbo.ConfigEntries ce ON ce.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND ce.snapshotId = l.snapshotId AND l.rn = 1 JOIN dbo.FabricItems fi ON fi.workspace_id = ce.workspace_id AND fi.snapshotId = ce.snapshotId AND fi.fabricId = ce.itemFabricId WHERE ce.section = 'Report pages' GROUP BY fi.displayName, l.displayName, ce.label ORDER BY report, page
What sources does each data agent use?: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, snapshotId, displayName, fabricDomainId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces) SELECT fi.displayName AS data_agent, l.displayName AS workspace, ce.label AS source, ce.value AS source_type_and_item FROM latest l JOIN dbo.ConfigEntries ce ON ce.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND ce.snapshotId = l.snapshotId AND l.rn = 1 JOIN dbo.FabricItems fi ON fi.workspace_id = ce.workspace_id AND fi.snapshotId = ce.snapshotId AND fi.fabricId = ce.itemFabricId WHERE ce.section = 'Data agent sources' ORDER BY data_agent, source
List the foreign keys of the SQL databas: WITH latest AS (SELECT fabricId, snapshotId, displayName, fabricDomainId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fabricId ORDER BY syncedAt DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Workspaces) SELECT fi.displayName AS item, fi.itemType, ce.label AS foreign_key, ce.value AS definition FROM latest l JOIN dbo.ConfigEntries ce ON ce.workspace_id = l.fabricId AND ce.snapshotId = l.snapshotId AND l.rn = 1 JOIN dbo.FabricItems fi ON fi.workspace_id = ce.workspace_id AND fi.snapshotId = ce.snapshotId AND fi.fabricId = ce.itemFabricId WHERE ce.section = 'SQL Foreign keys' ORDER BY item, foreign_key
